payload.reason: The evidence provides specific correlations between different ROUGE variants and their effectiveness in evaluating summaries, indicating that different variants yield different correlation results.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE result in varying correlations with manual evaluations, indicating that not all ROUGE scores are equally effective.
ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 show better correlations with manual judgments compared to other variants like ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L.
Keyword-based reduction variants have high correlations with ROUGE, while many other variants do not correlate well with human pyramid scores.
